# Sule Malik — Product-Minded Software Engineer
> Portfolio & Technical Dossier of Sule Malik, software engineer based in Asante Mampong, Ghana, specializing in scalable web applications, SaaS platforms, high-performance mobile apps, and product architecture.

## Overview & Bio
I'm Sule Malik — a product-minded software engineer based in Asante Mampong, Ghana. I build customer-facing web applications, SaaS platforms, interactive dashboards, and e-commerce experiences that combine functionality, performance, and thoughtful design.

My focus is on the intersection of product engineering and user experience: where sound architecture, clean implementation, and real user needs come together. I go beyond implementing features; I consider edge cases, optimize application performance down to sub-100ms interactions, and build maintainable codebases designed to scale and evolve.

## Active Research & Continuous Learning Domains

1. **AI & Agentic Engineering (AI / A1)**: Integrating Large Language Models, streaming protocols (Vercel AI SDK), model context protocols (MCP), and deterministic fallbacks into product workflows so AI interactions feel snappy and dependable.
2. **Product Analytics & Telemetry**: Designing semantic event taxonomies, measuring conversion funnels, and analyzing retention curves with tools like PostHog and Mixpanel to inform architectural decisions with user telemetry.
3. **Technical & Structural SEO**: Deepening web visibility through automated Schema.org JSON-LD microdata, semantic document structures, and green-tier Core Web Vitals (sub-1.2s LCP, zero layout shifts).
4. **AEO & GEO (Answer & Generative Engine Optimization)**: Optimizing content discovery for AI synthesis engines like ChatGPT Search, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews using citation grounding and entity mapping.
5. **Advanced React Native & 60fps Craft**: Perfecting fluid gesture choreography with React Native Gesture Handler, UI-thread worklets via Reanimated 3, and offline-first local data synchronization.

## Operating Principles
1. **Clarity Over Cleverness**: Good software is clear before it is clever. Explicit types and straightforward data flows outlast trends.
2. **Product-Led Problem Solving**: Interrogate who the feature is for and what measurable success looks like before writing code.
3. **Craft & Micro-Interactions**: Motion and responsiveness communicate trustworthiness. 60fps gestures and instant visual feedback matter.
4. **Autonomous Collaboration**: Clear written documentation, proactive communication, and end-to-end accountability in remote environments.
